"Uniform fair dice" are dice where all faces have an equal probability of outcome due to the symmetry of the die as it is [face-transitive](/wiki/Isohedral_figure "Isohedral figure"). In addition to the Platonic solids, these theoretically include:

* [Catalan solids](/wiki/Catalan_solid "Catalan solid"), the [duals](/wiki/Dual_polyhedron "Dual polyhedron") of the 13 [Archimedean solids](/wiki/Archimedean_solid "Archimedean solid"): 12, 24, 30, 48, 60, 120 sides
* [Trapezohedra](/wiki/Trapezohedron "Trapezohedron"), the duals of the infinite set of [antiprisms](/wiki/Antiprism "Antiprism"), with kite faces: any even number not divisible by 4 (so that a facet faces up), starting from 6
* [Bipyramids](/wiki/Bipyramid "Bipyramid"), the duals of the infinite set of [prisms](/wiki/Prism_(geometry) "Prism (geometry)"), with triangle faces: any multiple of 4 (so that a facet faces up), starting from 8
* [Disphenoids](/wiki/Disphenoid "Disphenoid"), an infinite set of tetrahedra made from congruent non-regular triangles: 4 sides. This is a less symmetric tetrahedron than the Platonic tetrahedron but still sufficiently symmetrical to be face-transitive. Similarly, [pyritohedra](/wiki/Pyritohedron "Pyritohedron") and [tetartoids](/wiki/Tetartoid "Tetartoid") are less symmetrical but still face-transitive dodecahedra: 12 sides.

Two other types of polyhedra are technically not face-transitive but are still fair dice due to symmetry:

* [antiprisms](/wiki/Antiprism "Antiprism"): the basis of [barrel dice](/wiki/Barrel_dice "Barrel dice")
* [prisms](/wiki/Prism_(geometry) "Prism (geometry)"): the basis of long dice and teetotums

Individual volumes of *One Piece* have broken publishing and sales records in Japan. In 2009, the 56th volume had a print run of 2.85 million, the highest initial print run of any manga by then.[[149]](#cite_note-166) The 57th volume had a print run of 3 million in 2010,[[150]](#cite_note-167) a record that was broken several times by subsequent volumes. The 60th volume had a first print run of 3.4 million and was the first book to sell over two million copies in its opening week on Oricon book rankings,[[151]](#cite_note-168)[[152]](#cite_note-169) and later became the first book to sell over three million copies in Oricon's history.[[153]](#cite_note-170) In 2012, the 67th volume had an initial print run of 4.05 million, holding the record of the volume with the highest number of copies in the first print.[[154]](#cite_note-171) *One Piece* is the only manga that had an initial print of volumes of above 3 million continuously for more than ten years.[[155]](#cite_note-oricon.co.jp-172) In May 2023, it was reported that each of the 105 volumes, published by then, had sold over 1 million copies.[[156]](#cite_note-173) Additionally, *One Piece* is the only work whose volumes have ranked first every year in Oricon's weekly comic chart existence since 2008.[[157]](#cite_note-174)[[158]](#cite_note-100vol-1million-ANN-175)

The [snow leopard](/wiki/Snow_leopard "Snow leopard") is the official national animal of Afghanistan.

Several types of mammals exist throughout Afghanistan. [Snow leopards](/wiki/Snow_leopard "Snow leopard") and [brown bears](/wiki/Brown_bear "Brown bear") live in the high elevation [alpine tundra](/wiki/Alpine_tundra "Alpine tundra") regions. The [Marco Polo sheep](/wiki/Marco_Polo_sheep "Marco Polo sheep") exclusively live in the Wakhan Corridor region of north-east Afghanistan. Foxes, [wolves](/wiki/Wolves "Wolves"), [otters](/wiki/Otter "Otter"), [deer](/wiki/Deer "Deer"), [wild sheep](/wiki/Wild_sheep "Wild sheep"), [lynx](/wiki/Lynx "Lynx") and other big cats populate the mountain forest region of the east. In the semi-desert northern plains, wildlife include a variety of birds, [hedgehogs](/wiki/Hedgehog "Hedgehog"), [gophers](/wiki/Gopher "Gopher"), and large carnivores such as [jackals](/wiki/Golden_jackal "Golden jackal") and [hyenas](/wiki/Striped_hyena "Striped hyena").[[275]](#cite_note-Gritzner-2009-286)
